title: A Multimodal Screening and Validation Framework for Polymer Glass-Transition Temperature Design
key_findings: Proposed a framework that couples generation, multimodal screening, and selective physics-based validation for polymer design.
Developed a variational autoencoder combining PolyBERT encoder with Transformer decoder for large-scale sampling in continuous latent space.
Designed a hybrid model integrating graph neural networks (GNNs) operating on molecular graphs with PolyBERT sequence representations.
methods: Multimodal T prediction combining graph and sequence information

numerical_results.value: Outperforms conventional molecular fingerprints and PolyBERT baselines

limitations: Existing T data are often collected under different measurement protocols and conditions
